senses.gloss: m. (preced.) irrigation; של ש׳ (שדה) a field requiring irrigation.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 2:4">Tosef. Shebi. II, 4</cite> <he>בשל ש׳</he> in a field depending on irrigation, opp. <he>של בעל</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16">Num. R. s. 16<sup>25</sup></cite> <he>של שקי</he> (not <cite ref="U01894"><he>שקר</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="B01055"><he>בַּעַל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 10:4:2">Y. Ter. X, 47ᵇ</cite> top <he>כרוב של ש׳</he> (not <he>שקיא</he>) cabbage from an irrigated field.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 10:4:2">Ib.</cite> bot.; a. fr.
